limits: All15 pages rendered and visually inspected across preparation turns; full original text retained. No calibration execution, input-file/raw-header reproduction or publisher product crosswalk.

targetedVisualNotes.page3: Version1 July2022 first PDS delivery; version2 June2023 review/minor edits for second delivery and liens. Document history, not image acquisition dates.
targetedVisualNotes.page9: Pipeline diagram distinguishes raw MOC/SOC, partial processing and calibrated products; includes calibration-table addback, bias/dark/flat, electrons and saturation flags, radiance, selected I/F and special-pixel updates. Not independently executed.
page14: Radiance described at622nm pivot wavelength for an object the colour of Didymos, with one photometric conversion and possible corrections for different-colour objects; not calibrated RGB colour.
Radiance products retain negative values to represent background noise; _rad_ filename convention.
Terminal/Final I/F conversion is dimensionless using heliocentric distance and F_SUN622=1.6784 W m^-2 nm^-1 as printed. No independent calibration or calculation performed.
Negative I/F values replaced by IOVRFLAG=-1E08; _iof_ naming convention. Do not treat special values as terrain.
page15: BADMASKV=-1E09; pipeline document states no pixels were flagged by the bad-pixel map. No raw-image reproduction or universal detector-quality claim.
Out-of-window=-1E10, missing=+1E10; original window/missing keywords and calibrated updates remain distinct.
Listed FITS keyword names do not identify a specific retained publisher PNG/JPEG or establish its processing history.
page5: SOC scientific calibration is distinct from onboard SMART Nav processing. This document describes procedure, explicitly not calibration activities/results.
Fletcher2022 DOI10.1117/12.2627873 and a future2023 Ernst publication are references, not verified raw-image processing or publication-status audits.
page6: DRACO SIS takes precedence in a conflict. Pipeline inputs described as16bit1024square FITS,2x2 binned from2048square; some downlinks512square placed into original frame with PXOUTWIN. Publisher985squarePNG dimensions do not independently identify this raw geometry.

Onboard table updated2022-06-07; CALSTART selects version. CALIB=TRUE prose differs from numeric4095/on versus0/off in page9 diagram and ON/OFF in page10/SIS. Retained final FITS CALIB=ON does not independently reproduce the pipeline.
All-zero bad-pixel-map statement is historical pipeline description, not noise-free detector/terrain claim.
page7: Global-shutter bias frames zero as ofNovember2022; dark-current frames zero because dark signal could not be measured separately from bias, not proof of physically zero dark current.
Prose describes initial ground flat refined with in-flight star clusters; best-effort radiometry depends on source/target/instrument spectra and shutter/gain.
622nm pivot wavelength does not establish narrowband acquisition or calibrated visible RGB colour.
page8: Table1 labels flat-field data source ground-test only while page7 prose explicitly describes in-flight refinement; preserve description/table distinction, no silent source repair or assumed calibration-file identity.
Table1 credits SMART Nav Carolyn Sawyer; DRACO Syau-Yun Hsieh and Andy Cheng, flat-field row also Tony Farnham. Ground/cruise delivery counts are table metadata, not observation dates.
Specific calibrated FITS header must retain input filenames/scalar values; these have not been linked to publisher imagery.
targetedVisualNotes.page1: DRACO Calibration Pipeline Description Version2 cover; artwork is not scientific terrain and is not extracted/embedded.
targetedVisualNotes.page4: Contents confirms inputs, prechecks, electrons/radiance/I-F conversion and special-pixel/header updates.
targetedVisualNotes.page10: CALIB table uses ON/OFF, unlike page6 TRUE and page9 numeric4095/0. Representation differences retained; original final FITS also states ON. Shutter/gain/temperature/truncation/exposure determine inputs; no pipeline execution.
targetedVisualNotes.page11: BADIMAGE and test-pattern/DARK/BIAS observations have raw-SOC products but no corresponding calibrated image according to document. Correct-looking headers do not guarantee valid detector-reconfiguration pixels.
page12: Rows0–511 detectorA and512–1023 detectorB use separate conversions; radiometric tables start row0 but instrument kernel starts row1. Not applied as a pixel shift or calibration repair.
TESTTEMP matching DETTEMP1 is input-file selection, not observer/local surface temperature.
page13: Visually rechecked page13: MSB uses x=output4/2; LSB uses x=output4/4. Both multiply the lookup electron value by4. Earlier unpublished preparation incorrectly described identical divisors; corrected before publication. No pipeline execution.
Saturated raw DN4094 mapped SATPXVAL=+1E09; below4094 but above lookup limit maps OORADLUT=+1E08. Table3 cutoffs apply to processed output4, not raw image values.
Table3 row-specific shutter/gain cutoffs not assigned to retained publisher PNG/JPEG without original FITS/raw calibration identity.
Rolling-shutter negative-signal lookup handling differs from global-shutter exact-zero handling described page14; not terrain or detector-noise removal proof.
